items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a drummer who played in the WPA band with Lutellis who used to play the tuba, and the drummer, after Juve Baby was Walter Tendill

ctx.x: Were there any other drummers, obviously Sonny Greer playing with Duke Ellington that made an impression on you in those early days?

Well there was a drummer who played in the WPA band with Lutellis who used to play the tuba, and the drummer, after Juve Baby was Walter Tendill and I always thought that he was going to be a good drummer but he just, he didn’t want to pursuer it. He could play, he kept good time and he owned a set of drums, he had a bass drum and a snare (laughs) to me that was a whole set of drums! That was a whole set!
When did you get your first instrument?
